runs.skip: PENDING W405 (#467): xppautX labels no R1 at c=-1, b=1/4, where AUTO-07p does. The torus system is singular at R1 (the model's (w,v) block is then exactly the identity), and Newton there reaches epsu only if the eigenfunction is small: AUTO-07p's start run lost its first eight steps to non-convergence and left its norm at 7.6e-7, xppautX's converges at once and leaves 2.1e-2, where the difference-quotient Jacobian's noise keeps the update at 1e-5. With the eigenfunction scaled to 7.6e-7, or with the exact Jacobian, xppautX finds R1 at AUTO-07p's place to every digit; the scale is not copied, since hill_cycles_pd and hill_cycles_torus, whose start runs end where xppautX's do (2.06e-2), agree and would not
